system.description:
Effect: Until you use a ten-minute or longer recovery, you can see through opaque matter. As an action, you can concentrate on something within immediate range, seeing through it to a depth of 2 feet (60 cm) for one round as if it were transparent. You can see through substances up to level 6 (typically wood, flesh, plastic, stone, and even metal, but specially reinforced or exotic materials may remain opaque).

Genre Items: crystal lens of piercing vision (fantasy); x-ray goggles (sci-fi)
